title: सप्तत्रिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Dhritarashtra asks who stood against the boy, and Sanjaya tells how Abhimanyu's arrows made even the creatures cry out in praise. He pierces Drona's own host while the Kauravas turn away.
summary.kn: ಆ ಬಾಲಕನ ಮುಂದೆ ಯಾರು ನಿಂತರೆಂದು ಧೃತರಾಷ್ಟ್ರ ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಅಭಿಮನ್ಯುವಿನ ಬಾಣಗಳಿಗೆ ಜೀವಿಗಳೂ ಹೊಗಳಿದುದನ್ನು ಸಂಜಯ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಅವನು ದ್ರೋಣನ ಕಣ್ಣೆದುರೇ ಸೈನ್ಯವನ್ನು ಭೇದಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ, ಕೌರವರು ಮುಖ ತಿರುಗಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
summary.hi: धृतराष्ट्र पूछते हैं कि उस बालक के सामने कौन टिका, और संजय बताते हैं कि अभिमन्यु के बाणों से प्राणी भी जयकार करने लगे। वह द्रोण के सामने ही सेना को बींधता है और कौरव मुँह फेर लेते हैं।
summary.te: ఆ బాలుని ఎదుట ఎవరు నిలిచారని ధృతరాష్ట్రుడు అడుగుతాడు; అభిమన్యుని బాణాలకు ప్రాణులు కూడా ప్రశంసించాయని సంజయుడు చెబుతాడు. అతడు ద్రోణుని ఎదుటే సేనను ఛేదిస్తాడు, కౌరవులు వెనుదిరుగుతారు.
summary.ta: அச்சிறுவன் முன் யார் நின்றனர் என்று த்ருதராஷ்டிரன் கேட்கிறான்; அபிமன்யுவின் அம்புகளுக்கு உயிர்களும் புகழ்ந்ததாகச் சஞ்சயன் கூறுகிறான். த்ரோணரின் முன்பே படையைத் துளைக்க, கௌரவர் முகம் திருப்புகின்றனர்.
summary.ml: ആ ബാലനെതിരെ ആരാണ് നിന്നതെന്ന് ധൃതരാഷ്ട്രർ ചോദിക്കുന്നു; അഭിമന്യുവിന്റെ അമ്പുകൾ ജീവികളെപ്പോലും സ്തുതിച്ചു വിളിക്കാൻ പ്രേരിപ്പിച്ചതായി സഞ്ജയൻ പറയുന്നു. കൗരവർ പിന്തിരിയുമ്പോൾ അദ്ദേഹം ദ്രോണരുടെ സ്വന്തം സേനയെയും തുളയ്ക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 7.37; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Sep 22 2026

verses.text: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच

meaning.en: Dhritarashtra said:

verses.text:
तथा प्रमथमानं तं महेष्वासमजिह्मगैः ।
आर्जुनिं मामकाः सर्वे के त्वेनं समवाकिरन् ॥

meaning.en: As the son of Arjuna, a great archer, was crushing them with straight arrows, which of my men covered him with their arrows?

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
शृणु राजन्कुमारस्य रणे विक्रीडितं महत् ।
बिभित्सतो रथानीकं भारद्वाजेन रक्षितम् ॥

meaning.en: Hear, O king, the great sport of the young man in battle, who wished to break the chariot division guarded by Bharadvaja's son.

verses.text:
मद्रेशं सादितं दृष्ट्वा सौभाद्रेणाशुगै रणे ।
शल्यादवरजः क्रुद्धः किरन्बाणान्समभ्ययात् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing the Madra king struck down by Subhadra's son with swift arrows, Shalya's younger brother, angry, advanced showering arrows.

verses.text:
स विद्ध्वा दशभिर्बाणैः साश्वयन्तारमार्जुनिम् ।
उदक्रोशन्महाशब्दं तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: He pierced Arjuna's son with ten arrows, with his horses and charioteer, shouted loudly, and said, "Stand! Stand!"

verses.text:
तस्यार्जुनिः शिरोग्रीवं पाणिपादं धनुर्हयान् ।
छत्रं ध्वजं नियन्तारं त्रिवेणुं शम्युपस्करम् ॥

meaning.en: Arjuna's son with his arrows cut off his head and neck, hands, feet, bow and horses, umbrella, banner, charioteer, the chariot's triple pole and fittings,

verses.text:
चक्रे युगेषां तूणीराननुकर्षं च सायकैः ।
पताकां चक्रगोप्तारौ सर्वोपकरणानि च ।
व्यधमल्लाघवात्तच्च ददृशे नास्य कश्चन ॥

meaning.en: its yoke, shafts, quivers, its trailing gear, the pennant, the two wheel-guards and all the equipment, so swiftly that nobody saw it done.

verses.text:
स पपात क्षितौ क्षीणः प्रविद्धाभरणाम्बरः ।
वायुनेव महाचैत्यः संभग्नोऽमिततेजसा ।
अनुगाश्चास्य वित्रस्ताः प्राद्रवन्सर्वतोदिशम् ॥

meaning.en: He fell to the ground, destroyed, his ornaments and garments scattered, like a great sacred tree broken by a wind of boundless force; his followers, terrified, fled in all directions.

verses.text:
आर्जुनेः कर्म तद्दृष्ट्व प्रणेदुश्च समन्ततः ।
नादेन सर्वभूतानि साधु साध्विति भारत ॥

meaning.en: Seeing that deed of Arjuna's son, all beings shouted from every side with cheers, "Well done, well done!" O Bharata.

verses.text:
शल्यभ्रातर्यथारुग्णे बहुशस्तस्य सैनिकाः ।
कुलाधिवासनामानि श्रावयन्तोऽर्जुनात्मजम् ॥

meaning.en: When Shalya's brother was struck down, his soldiers, again and again, announcing the names of their families and homes to Arjuna's son,

verses.text:
अभ्यवर्तन्त संक्रुद्धा विविधायुधपाणयः ।
रथैरश्वैर्गजैश्चान्ये पादातैश्च बलोत्कटाः ॥

meaning.en: advanced in great fury with weapons of many kinds in hand, some on chariots, horses and elephants, and others, strong men, on foot.

verses.text:
बाणशब्देन महता खुरनेमिस्वनेन च ।
हुंकारैः क्ष्वेडितोत्क्रुष्टैः सिंहनादैः सगर्जितैः ॥

meaning.en: With a great noise of arrows, the sound of hooves and wheel-rims, hum cries, shouts, lion-roars and thunder,

verses.text:
ज्यातलत्रस्वनैरन्ये गर्जन्तोऽर्जुननन्दनम् ।
ब्रुवन्तश्च न नो जीवन्मोक्ष्यसे जीवतामिति ॥

meaning.en: others roaring at Arjuna's son with the sound of bowstrings against palms, and saying "You will not escape us alive while we live."

verses.text:
तांस्तथा ब्रुवतो दृष्ट्वा सौभद्रः प्रहसन्निव ।
यो यः स्म प्राहरत्पूर्वं तं तं विव्याध पत्रिभिः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing them speak so, Subhadra's son smiled and pierced with arrows whoever struck first.

verses.text:
संदर्शयिष्यन्नस्त्राणि चित्राणि च लघूनि च ।
आर्जुनिः समरे शूरो मृदुपूर्वमयुध्यत ॥

meaning.en: Wishing to show his weapons, strange and swift, Arjuna's son, brave in battle, fought gently at first.

verses.text:
वासुदेवादुपात्तं यद्यदस्त्रं च धनंजयात् ।
अदर्शयत तत्कार्ष्णिः कृष्णाभ्यामविशेषयन् ॥

meaning.en: Whatever weapon he had received from Vasudeva and from Dhananjaya, Krishna's son showed, making no difference from the two Krishnas.

verses.text:
दूरमस्यन्गुरुं भारं साधयंश्च पुनः पुनः ।
संदधद्विसृजंश्चेषून्निर्विशेषमदृश्यत ॥

meaning.en: Shooting far, accomplishing his heavy burden again and again, fitting and loosing arrows, he looked no different from them.

verses.text:
चापमण्डलमेवास्य विस्फुरद्दिक्ष्वदृश्यत ।
तमो घ्नतः सुदीप्तस्य सवितुर्मण्डलं यथा ॥

meaning.en: Only the circle of his bow was seen flashing in the directions, like the circle of the blazing sun that destroys darkness.

verses.text:
ज्याशब्दः शुश्रुवे तस्य तलशब्दश्च दारुणः ।
महाशनिमुचः काले पयोदस्येव निस्वनः ॥

meaning.en: The sound of his bowstring and the dreadful slap of his palm were heard, like the roar of a cloud letting loose a great thunderbolt in season.

verses.text:
ह्रीमानमर्षी सौभद्रो मानकृत्प्रियदर्शनः ।
संमिमानयिषुर्वीरानिष्वासांश्चाप्ययुध्यत ॥

meaning.en: Modest, unforgiving, honoring others and pleasant to behold, Subhadra's son fought even great archers, wishing to honor heroes.

verses.text:
मृदुर्भूत्वा महाराज दारुणः समपद्यत ।
वर्षाभ्यतीतो भगवाञ्शरदीव दिवाकरः ॥

meaning.en: Becoming gentle, O great king, he turned fierce, like the blessed sun in autumn after the rains.

verses.text:
शरान्विचित्रान्महतो रुक्मपुङ्खाञ्शिलाशितान् ।
मुमोच शतशः क्रुद्धो गभस्तीनिव भास्करः ॥

meaning.en: He loosed in hundreds, in anger, wonderful great gold-feathered arrows, sharpened on stone, like the sun its rays.

verses.text:
क्षुरप्रैर्वत्सदन्तैश्च विपाठैश्च महायशाः ।
नाराचैरर्धनाराचैर्भल्लैरज्ञलिकैरपि ॥

meaning.en: With kshurapras, calf-tooth arrows, vipathas, naracha and half-naracha arrows, broad-headed and anjalika arrows,

verses.text:
अवाकिरद्रथानीकं भारद्वाजस्य पश्यतः ।
ततस्तत्सैन्यमभवद्विमुखं शरपीडितम् ॥

meaning.en: the very famous one showered the chariot division of Bharadvaja's son in his sight; then that army turned away, tormented by arrows.
